## Ravenfield VR (next, after 1.16.14)

- A pistol drawn in a car seat is put away when you switch to a seat with its own weapon (the driver's horn, a gun): it stayed out, and in the driver seat every button went to the horn, seat switching too.
- The frame rate hold no longer flips the render scale back and forth when the processor is what holds the frame rate back (each flip was a short hitch); it lowers the render scale only after the graphics card is busy for a while.
- A submarine's crew no longer gets water drops on the view when it surfaces.
- In deep water, grabbing a soldier's gun knocks it aside instead of throwing it into the water, and a goggles grab at a holster tells you nothing happened (the game toggles nothing there).
- With the magazine pouch on the chest, it moves to the free hand's side when you pass the gun to your other hand (it stayed on the gun arm's side).
